response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile software craftsman with 15+ years across web, mobile, embedded, and infrastructure work, and solid TypeScript/Node.js and cloud (AWS CDK) exposure. However, the role requires 8+ years specifically building production-grade AI/GenAI solutions with RAG, vector databases, and multi-agent frameworks, and his resume shows only a few months (current role since April 2025) touching MCP tooling and agentic infrastructure, with no evidence of RAG architectures, vector DB work, LLM evaluation/optimization, or customer-facing technical discovery leadership for AI systems.
strengths: 15+ years of proven full-stack engineering experience across diverse domains and languages
Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, workshop creation, and open-source project ownership
Recent hands-on exposure to MCP (Model Context Protocol) and agentic workflow tooling
concerns: No demonstrated 8-year track record building production AI/GenAI systems as required
No evidence of RAG architecture, vector database, or LLM evaluation/optimization experience
No mention of leading technical discovery sessions or customer-facing solution design for AI products

key_factors.factor: Lack of substantial GenAI/RAG/vector DB experience
Strong general software engineering and cloud (AWS) background
